title: Dimensional Metrology Field Map (0.1 nm to 100 m)
summary: An honest taxonomy of dimensional metrology across twelve orders of magnitude, showing which branches live in Metrology Maven's 1.0 core, which are scheduled post-1.0 core expansions (D-054), and which stay behind ECO.SDK plugins or companion projects.

tiers.label: Core 1.0 Platform
tiers.description: Macro-scale 3D coordinate, scan-to-CAD, GD&T, uncertainty, reporting and portable-network workflows across the four focused apps (Report, Inspect, Probe, Network).

tiers.label: Post-1.0 Core Expansion (D-054)
tiers.description: High-leverage industrial metrology tracks aligned with the CPU-only KNP-1 kernel, HAL and UNC architecture: MSA & non-normal capability (P3), surface texture & precision form (P3), and calibration-lab verification (P4).

tiers.label: ECO.SDK Plugin / Companion Scope (D-054)
tiers.description: Specialized modalities with distinct physics, multi-gigabyte voxel/image compute, or proprietary controller ecosystems kept outside core to preserve C1/C2 determinism and QIF-native simplicity.

pillars.title: 3D Coordinate, CMM & Optical Scan-to-CAD Metrology
pillars.why: Forms the shared geometric fitting, alignment, scan comparison and CMM execution backbone of Inspect and Probe.

pillars.title: GD&T, Measurement Uncertainty & Conformance Decision Rules
instruments: Applies to every dimensional instrument and manual reading
pillars.why: Every reported dimensional value needs an explicit geometric definition, an honest evidence class (UEC-0..3), a typed decision rule and cryptographic replayability.

pillars.title: Large-Volume & Multi-Instrument Metrology Networks
pillars.why: Powers Metrology Maven Network for aerospace, energy and heavy-tooling bundle adjustment and live fixture guidance.

pillars.title: Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), VDA 5 & Non-Normal Capability
instruments: Aggregates results across CMMs, scanners, vision systems and hand gauges
pillars.why: Small architectural lift (~80-120 leaves) with universal manufacturing demand: geometric tolerances like position and runout are non-normal and require VDA 5 / ANOVA MSA.

pillars.title: Surface Texture, ISO 16610 Filtration & Precision Form/Contour
pillars.why: Completes CONSTITUTION §7 P3 'Form and texture' and plugs directly into existing HAL.IDL.SENS.SURF (HeightMap@1, Profile@1) and UNC.ORS.FLT hooks.

pillars.title: Calibration-Lab Metrology & Instrument/Machine Verification
instruments: Step gauges, thread wires & ring/plug masters
pillars.why: Unifies accredited physical verification, CMC/TUR guardbanding, Digital Calibration Certificates and out-of-tolerance impact tracking on top of UNC and TRUST.

pillars.title: 2D / 2.5D Optical & Vision Measuring Machines (VMM)
pillars.why: Requires real-time sub-pixel image processing, programmable lighting hardware control and 2D DXF/Gerber stacks better isolated in an ECO.SDK vision plugin.

pillars.title: Industrial X-Ray Computed Tomography (CT) & Volumetric Metrology
instruments: Cone-beam & helical industrial X-ray CT scanners
pillars.why: Multi-gigabyte voxel volumes (2048^3) and tomographic reconstruction require specialized volumetric storage and compute architectures outside core C1 CPU-only f64.

pillars.title: On-Machine CNC Probing (OMV) & Closed-Loop Tool Offsets
instruments: Spindle touch probes & laser tool setters on 3/5-axis CNC machines
pillars.why: Controller-specific G-code macro generation and closed-loop CNC write-back require distinct safety policies beyond read-only shop-floor telemetry and I++ DME.

pillars.title: Micro-, Nano-, Semiconductor & Optical Wavefront Metrology
pillars.why: Relies on wave-optics phase unwrapping, Zernike aberration fitting, tip-sample blind reconstruction and wafer hierarchies outside macro rigid-body QIF geometry.

pillars.title: Adjacent Dimensional Engineering (Stack-Up, Reverse Engineering, DIC)
pillars.why: 3D tolerance stack-up simulation, NURBS surface reconstruction and optical strain/DIC cross from measurement into CAD modeling and experimental mechanics (see seeds/out-of-scope.md).
